messages:
Ava W: Quick q — I opened a tiny PR to standardize a few microcopy bits around model naming in the SDK snippets. Mostly: should we prefer `model` (short) or `model_version` (explicit) in examples?
Ben K: leaning `model` for examples, keeps snippets compact. but we need a note in the guide about when to be explicit (enterprise/private docs).
Carlos M: Agree with Ben. For API reference use `model_version` where it's required, but quickstart snippets should be short and copy-pastable.
Dana S: We hit customer confusion when the param name changed in the CLI->SDK migration, so a 1-sentence callout in migration guide would help.
Ava W: Good point. I'll add a short callout: "Example snippets use `model` for brevity; production manifests should reference `model_version` where stability matters." Thoughts on wording?
Elaine P: Maybe: "Use `model` in quickstarts; use `model_version` when pinning exact model builds for production." Keeps it prescriptive.
Ben K: +1. Also, update the glossary entry for "model" to link to the glossary item for model versioning.
docs-bot: PR opened — <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321|redwood-inference/docs#4321> by @avaw (files changed: sdk/snippets.md, migration/cli-to-sdk.md, glossary.md)
Ava W: Thanks bot. @Ben K can you review the wording around the migration callout? it's just a new paragraph and a one-line note in the snippet block.
Ben K: On it, will review today. If small, I'll approve and leave a suggestion to add a code comment explaining `model` vs `model_version`.
Dana S: Suggest adding one inline snippet showing both: 1) minimal quickstart `client.generate({ model: "llama-3" })` and 2) pinned `client.generate({ model_version: "llama-3-v2" })` — helps reduce support pings.
Ava W: Good idea. I'll add both examples. Any objections to also adding a short "When to pin" bullet in migration guide?
Carlos M: No objections. Keep bullets 2-3 lines max. We can reference the Optimize playbook later.
Elaine P: I can help craft the "When to pin" bullets — will send a suggested blurb in a follow-up message.
Ben K: Reviewed and left two tiny phrasing suggestions. LGTM otherwise.
aVaW: (typo) fixed and pushed.
docs-bot: PR updated — <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321|redwood-inference/docs#4321> (now includes dual-snippet example and glossary crosslink)
Ava W: Final ask: who can own the glossary merge? the change touches `model` and `model version` entries. Might need the docs steward to sign off.
Carlos M: @Elaine P can shepherd the glossary merge and coordinate with lexicon steward.
Elaine P: Happy to. I'll open a follow-up PR for the glossary with the approved blurb and ping lexicon stewards.
Ava W: Amazing — thanks everyone. I'll mark the PR ready once Ben's suggestions are in and Elaine has the glossary PR link.
Ben K: Approved now.
Elaine P: I'll post the glossary PR link in this thread when it's up. 
Ava W: Closing loop: action items
- Ava: merge docs PR after Ben's final nit and once glossary PR linked
- Elaine: open glossary PR and coordinate lexicon sign-off
- Ben: review/approve quickstart wording (done)
- Dana: file a short support-note template for migration questions (optional)
